sn9.5:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Ānando Kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe || || 2.
sn9.5:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Ānando ativelaṃ gihisaññattibahulo viharati || || 3.
sn9.5:1.3: Atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā āyasmato Ānandassa anukampikā atthakāmā āyasmantam Ānandam saṃvejetukāmā yenāyasmā Ānando ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Ānandaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn9.5:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando tāya devatāya saṃvejito saṃvegam āpādī ti || || 1.
